categories.main_business_segments: Bank of Chongqing operates primarily in corporate banking, retail banking, treasury, inclusive finance, financial markets, asset management, investment banking, and trade finance. It also controls subsidiaries engaged in financial leasing and village banking. The bank focuses on serving local economies, small and micro enterprises, urban and rural residents, and supports major regional strategies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The bank emphasizes digital transformation and technology empowerment, implementing a '456' digital transformation strategy and '1+3+10' financial technology development layout. It uses artificial intelligence, big data, RPA processes, OCR, and large language models to enhance risk control, customer service, and operational efficiency. The bank also builds intelligent risk control centers and promotes cloud computing and smart infrastructure.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include corporate entities, small and micro enterprises, individual consumers, agricultural households, and new citizens within the Chengdu-Chongqing Economic Circle and western China. The bank serves strategic customers, manufacturing industries, technology-based enterprises, green finance sectors, and rural revitalization projects. It also targets retail customers with wealth management, credit cards, and consumer loans.
categories.geographic_coverage: The bank operates 199 outlets covering Chongqing municipality and three provinces in western China: Sichuan, Guizhou, and Shaanxi. It has branches in major cities including Chengdu, Guiyang, and Xi’an, and extends services across all districts and counties within these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Bank of Chongqing operates primarily as a downstream financial services provider, offering banking products such as loans, deposits, wealth management, and investment banking services. It acts as a financial intermediary supporting the real economy, manufacturing, and inclusive finance sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The bank’s strategic focus includes service improvement, digital transformation, and characteristic development, supported by technology, talent, and management empowerment. It prioritizes innovation in financial technology, green finance, inclusive finance, pension finance, and digital finance. The bank invests in R&D for AI, big data, and digital credit products, and continuously upgrades its IT infrastructure and risk management systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through net interest income from loans and deposits, fee and commission income from wealth management, payment services, and agency services, as well as trading gains and investment securities income. The bank also earns income from investment banking underwriting, asset management, and financial leasing subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Bank of Chongqing is positioned as a leading urban commercial bank in western China, ranked 209th among the top 1000 world banks. It competes with other regional banks and national commercial banks by leveraging its local market knowledge, digital capabilities, and comprehensive financial services. It holds a strong market share in Chongqing and the surrounding provinces.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, the bank reported total assets of RMB 856.6 billion, total loans of RMB 440.6 billion, and total deposits of RMB 474.1 billion, reflecting year-on-year growth rates of 12.73%, 12.13%, and 14.30% respectively. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 5.12 billion, up 3.80% year-on-year. The bank maintains strong capital adequacy ratios and a stable asset quality with a non-performing loan ratio of 1.25%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The bank emphasizes its role as a local bank serving citizens and small and micro enterprises with tailored financial products and services. It differentiates through digital transformation, innovative financial technology applications, and comprehensive support for regional economic strategies such as the Chengdu-Chongqing Economic Circle and green finance initiatives. Its product offerings include specialized loans for manufacturing, technology, green projects, and rural revitalization, supported by efficient risk management and customer-centric service.
